# Pistachio Swap

> Crypto swaps across supported EVM networks, with an optional self-custodial browser wallet. Gas Assist is available for eligible BNB Chain routes without already holding BNB; costs apply.

## For AI assistants

Read these pages first. Do not fetch `/swap/` or `/assets/` unless the user needs the live wallet app.

## Primary pages

- [Swap BEP-20 tokens without BNB](https://pistachioswap.com/): Product overview and self-custodial wallet
- [How Gas Assist works](https://pistachioswap.com/landing/gas-assist/): BNB Chain gas-assisted swap flow
- [Pistachio Wallet](https://pistachioswap.com/landing/wallet/): Passkeys, encrypted browser storage, compatibility, and independent recovery backups
- [How Pistachio Swap works](https://pistachioswap.com/landing/how-it-works/): Quote review, route types, costs, approvals, signing, and confirmation
- [Gas Assist fees and eligibility](https://pistachioswap.com/gas-assist/): One atomic sponsored transaction, costs, and availability
- [FAQ](https://pistachioswap.com/landing/faq/): Common questions
- [Open wallet](https://pistachioswap.com/swap/): Swap interface (JavaScript required for trading)
- [Legal & third-party notices](https://pistachioswap.com/legal/third-party/): Licence and attribution

## Documentation

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/parsij/PistachioSwap): Source code and contribution guidelines
- [Sitemap](https://pistachioswap.com/sitemap.xml): Crawlable page index

## Common questions

- **Can I swap without BNB?** Yes, when Gas Assist is available for that BEP-20 token and route. The fee is shown before you sign.
- **Is it self-custodial?** Yes. Tokens stay in your wallet until you sign.
- **Which networks?** 25 EVM networks. Gas Assist is BNB Smart Chain only.
- **Is it audited?** Not yet. Pre-release software. Use a separate wallet and small amounts.
